concept.coreMechanic: A reusable, mana-paid hand jab releases a small magic spark from each enemy it directly contacts. The jab supplies reliable close-range impact while the sparks can continue toward the cursor into enemies behind the first contact. A 24-tick base use interval deliberately sits between the parents' 22- and 26-tick tempos.
concept.literalSynthesis: The Double-Canopy Copper Swordbrella retains its nested copper-ribbed and fabric umbrellas, with Жезл искр (Terraria/WandofSparking) incorporated as the central shaft. The wand tip protrudes through both canopy crowns as a small ember-bright point.
concept.parentAContribution: Double-Canopy Copper Swordbrella contributes the literal nested umbrella body, copper ribs, short fixed-axis front-hand jab, and once-per-enemy contact topology. Its surrounding area impact is replaced rather than inherited.
concept.parentBContribution: Жезл искр contributes its wand shaft and spark-shooting identity, inspiring newly authored contact-triggered magic sparks and a base mana cost of 2. The spark trajectory here is deliberately authored as a short downward-curving shot, not claimed as an observed source trajectory.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Jab along the initial cursor axis and release a forward spark from each direct enemy contact.

concept.playerExperience: Aim and click to jab, then steer the cursor toward a follow-through target before contact. Each contacted enemy can release one spark. The item is retained, needs no ammunition, and pays native mana at animation start; misses still cost mana. There is no shield, slow fall, or free ranged shot on a miss.
